name: qr-code-studio
description: Privacy-first, offline QR code and Code 128 barcode generator shipped as one standalone HTML file.

scripts.lint: node --check src/qr-core.js && node --check src/barcode-core.js && node --check src/app.js && node --check src/enhancements.js && node scripts/lint.mjs
scripts.test: node test/qr-core.test.mjs && node test/barcode-core.test.mjs && node test/repository.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint && npm test
